title: 6-O-angeloylplenolin inhibits osteoclastogenesis in vitro via suppressing c-Src/NF-kappaB/NFATc1 pathways and ameliorates bone resorption in collagen-induced arthritis mouse model.
authors: Li, Zhi-Chao; Li, Min; Xiao, Ling-Xiang; Zheng, Xi; Li, Rong; Dong, Shi-Jia; Wang, Yue; Wen, Hong-Yu; Ruan, Kun-Lin; Cheng, Ke-Guang; Chen, Ming; Tan, Yan-Hui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物6-OAP抑制破骨细胞生成及骨吸收，涉及c-Src/NF-kB/NFATc1通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: One of the effective therapeutic strategies to treat rheumatoid arthritis (RA)-related bone resorption is to target excessive activation of osteoclasts. We discovered that 6-O-angeloylplenolin (6-OAP), a pseudoguaianolide from Euphorbia thymifolia Linn widely used for the treatment of RA in traditional Chinese medicine, could inhibit RANKL-induced osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption in both RAW264.7 cells and BMMs from 1 muM and protect a collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) mouse model from bone destruction in vivo. The severity of arthritis and bone erosion observed in paw joints and the femurs of the CIA model were attenuated by 6-OAP administered at both dosages (1 or 5 mg/kg, i.g.). BMD, Tb.N and BV/TV were also improved by 6-OAP treatment. Histological analysis and TRAP staining of femurs further confirmed the protective effects of 6-OAP on bone erosion, which is mainly due to reduced osteoclasts. Molecular docking indicated that c-Src might be a target of 6-OAP and phosphorylation of c-Src was suppressed by 6-OAP treatment. CETSA and SPR assay further confirmed the potential interaction between 6-OAP and c-Src. Three signaling molecules downstream of c-Src that are vital to the differentiation and function of osteoclasts, NF-kappaB, c-Fos and NFATc1, were also suppressed by 6-OAP in vitro. In summary, the results demonstrated that the function of c-Src was disrupted by 6-OAP, which led to the suppression of downstream signaling vital to osteoclast differentiation and function. In conclusion, 6-OAP has the potential to be further developed for the treatment of RA-related bone erosion.
abstract_zh: 治疗类风湿关节炎（RA）相关骨吸收的有效治疗策略之一是靶向破骨细胞的过度活化。我们发现，6-O-当归酰基普列诺林（6-OAP），一种来自千屈菜（Euphorbia thymifolia Linn）的伪愈创木内酯，在传统中医中广泛用于治疗RA，能够从1 μM浓度起抑制RANKL诱导的破骨细胞生成和骨吸收，在RAW264.7细胞和BMMs中均有效，并在体内保护胶原诱导性关节炎（CIA）小鼠模型免受骨破坏。在CIA模型的爪关节和股骨中观察到的关节炎严重程度和骨侵蚀，通过6-OAP以两种剂量（1或5 mg/kg，灌胃）给药均得到减轻。骨密度（BMD）、骨小梁数量（Tb.N）和骨体积分数（BV/TV）也通过6-OAP治疗得到改善。股骨的组织学分析和TRAP染色进一步证实了6-OAP对骨侵蚀的保护作用，这主要归因于破骨细胞减少。分子对接表明c-Src可能是6-OAP的靶点，且6-OAP治疗抑制了c-Src的磷酸化。CETSA和SPR分析进一步确认了6-OAP与c-Src之间的潜在相互作用。c-Src下游对破骨细胞分化和功能至关重要的三个信号分子，NF-kappaB、c-Fos和NFATc1，在体外也被6-OAP抑制。总之，结果表明6-OAP破坏了c-Src的功能，导致对破骨细胞分化和功能至关重要的下游信号受到抑制。结论是，6-OAP有潜力进一步开发用于治疗RA相关骨侵蚀。
